text:
Maya: quick note 1 staging billing wobble: late arrivals (~3-5m) after compaction caused duplicated token attributions for a few requests. low volume but customer-visible.
Derek: can you share a tiny repro?
Maya: minimal event: {"tenant":"t-42","req":"r-77","tokens":12,"fp":"fp-77a","arrive_ts":1685001200} we dedupe upstream by fp+req.
Sasha: so compact ran, then late event created a second claim and finalizer accepted it?
Maya: exactly. compacted snapshot + late tail = duplicate path.
Omar: two fast options: widen slop (more watermark delay) or accept small slop and fix via an explicit repair flow in audit.
Derek: widening slop hurts realtime visibility. audit repairs make billing eventually consistent but preserve low latency for most users.
Sasha: proposal: tiny default slop (90-120s) + tombstone markers when we compact. Late events emit "tombstone-resolution" repair ops instead of creating credits directly.
Maya: tombstone + repair lets finalizer emit a repair_patch: {op:repair_patch,target_window:2026-03-22T10:00Z,fps:[fp-77a],action:merge|drop} consumed by a repair worker.
Omar: that feels operationally clean. we can throttle repairs and present deltas in the UI.
Derek: must be idempotent and preserve ledger invariants. require CAS on compact snapshot version; if CAS fails worker replays reconciliation.
Sasha: add an LRU index of recent fingerprints (24h TTL) in finalizer DB to speed resolution instead of scanning big compacts.
Maya: also decide raw event retention: 7d gives good repairability; 24h limits scope. tradeoffs for storage/cost.
Omar: UX: surface repair events in billing change feed and add a "repair-rate" metric per tenant with alerts.
Derek: cross-window long requests: canonical rule = attribute to request start window, mark split metadata; repairs can reassign split segments atomically.
Sasha: sketch repair_patch schema for audit stream: {type:repair_patch,tenant:tenant-42,target_window:2026-03-22T10:00:00Z,fps:[fp-77a],desired:{action:merge,to_request:r-77},proof:s3://proofs/...} finalizer returns {status:applied|noop|conflict,delta_tokens:12,seq:12345}.
Maya: action items: Sasha prototype tombstone+repair worker; Derek draft finalizer CAS contract and safety checks; Omar spec UI/alerts; Maya run slop=90s experiment in staging and collect repair candidates.
Derek: timeline ok?
Sasha: spike this week, staging next week.
infra-bot: branch metering-tombstones created and CI started (:white_check_mark:)
Maya: thanks team. small slop + explicit repairs seems least disruptive; iterate after staging metrics.
